name: The Austin Chronicle editorial board
lean_basis: AllSides Media Bias Rating: Left (independent review, low confidence, Oct 2026). Alt-weekly whose endorsements reflect its news staff and editors; its 2026 guide tells readers to 'Vote Democrat' in every statewide race.

name: Austin American-Statesman editorial board
lean_basis: Hearst-owned daily that resumed endorsements in 2026. AllSides' current page rates its news Center (independent review, low confidence, Aug 2026); an older duplicate AllSides page says Lean Left. Neither rates the editorial board, so under this guide's rule (a media-bias rating wins where one exists) it is labeled neutral. Its 2026 slate is mostly Democrats, with five Republican picks (Buckingham, Sheets, Teixeira, Pete Flores, Wilson) and no pick in TX-17, TX-31 or HD-73.

name: KUT News (Austin's NPR station)
lean_basis: Public radio newsroom; publishes candidate Q&As and voter guides and does not endorse.

name: Community Impact Newspaper
lean_basis: Free local newspaper chain; publishes candidate Q&As and a Nov 2026 voter guide with ballot language, and does not endorse.

name: League of Women Voters Austin Area
lean_basis: Nonpartisan 501(c)(3); publishes candidates' unedited answers and never endorses candidates.

name: Travis County Democratic Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization; its slate is the Democratic nominees.

name: Travis County Republican Party
lean_basis: Official county party organization. Posts support for specific nominees and the Prop I petition; no full local guide found for Nov 2026.

name: Stonewall Democrats of Austin
lean_basis: LGBTQ caucus affiliated with the Democratic Party.

name: Central Austin Democrats
lean_basis: Democratic club.

name: Black Austin Democrats
lean_basis: Democratic club.

name: Austin Environmental Democrats
lean_basis: Democratic club focused on environmental issues.

name: Austin Firefighters Association (IAFF Local 975)
lean_basis: Public-safety union; historically endorses across party lines in city races. Lean is a judgment call.

name: Austin Police Association
lean_basis: Police union; backed the 2021 Save Austin Now camping ban and the police staffing initiative. Lean is a judgment call.

name: Austin EMS Association
lean_basis: EMS employees' union; Selena Xie is its former president.

name: Austin Central Labor Council (AFL-CIO)
lean_basis: AFL-CIO regional body; endorsed only Democrats in partisan races.

name: Workers Defense Action Fund
lean_basis: Political arm of Workers Defense Project, a construction-worker advocacy group.

name: AURA
lean_basis: Volunteer urbanist group for more housing, transit and bike lanes; cross-partisan on housing but its 2026 picks are all incumbents or Democratic-aligned candidates.

name: Austin Board of REALTORS (TREPAC)
lean_basis: Industry trade group; its PAC gives to both parties. No Nov 2026 general-election guide found.

name: Real Estate Council of Austin
lean_basis: Commercial real estate trade group; 2026 guide backs Republicans in Hays and Williamson and Democrats in Travis.

name: Austin Apartment Association PAC
lean_basis: Landlord trade group; PAC page is members-only.

name: Greater Austin Chamber of Commerce
lean_basis: Business association; publishes legislative agendas, not candidate endorsements.

name: Save Austin Now PAC
lean_basis: Co-founded by former Travis County GOP chair Matt Mackowiak; authored Prop I. Describes itself as nonpartisan.

name: Travis County Taxpayers Union
lean_basis: Anti-tax group; no 2026 page found.

name: Austin Democratic Socialists of America
lean_basis: Socialist membership organization.
